༄༅/ /skyabs kyi thugs rje dang rang gzhan chos la bskul ba'i mgur bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyabs kyi thugs rje dang rang gzhan chos la bskul ba'i mgur bzhugs/

na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ sku rab mdzes mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis spras/ /gsung chos phung brgyad khri sgrogs pa can/ /thugs shes bya ma lus mngon gzigs pa/ /skyabs zla med ston pa de la 'dud/ /mgon khyod kyis dang por thugs bskyed de/ /bar grangs med gsum du tshogs gnyis bsags/ /mthar mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /chos zab rgyas 'khor lo rnam gsum bskor/ /thugs chags sdang nye ring mi mnga' yang*/ /khong gdul bya mchog dman bar ma la/ /theg gsum gyi chos tshul legs bstan nas/ /nges legs kyi byang chub gsum la bkod/ /dus gsum gyi rgyal ba gzhan dag gis/ /'dul ma nus ring du spangs pa'i 'gro /mgon khyod kyis brtse chen thabs mkhas kyis/ /'dul mdzad pa 'di nyid ngo mtshar rmad/ /zhing 'di sogs stong gsum bye ba brgyar/ /sku de snyed sprul te dga' ldan nas/ /'pho sogs kyi bcu gnyis mdzad pa'i tshul/ /cig car du mig 'phrul lta bur bstan/ /tshul de nyid phyogs dus gcig min par/ /phyogs kun dang 'jig rten ji srid bar/ /dus rgyun chad med par ston mdzad pa'i/ /'phrul de ko gzhan gyis bsam las 'das/ / skyabs khyod la skye 'chi mi mnga' yang*/ /dus tha ma'i gdul bya rtag 'dzin can/ / mi rtag pa'i chos la bskul ba'i ched/ /sku zhi ba'i dbyings su zhugs tshul bstan/ /da skal dman bdag cag mgon khyod sku/ /mngon sum du mjal ba'i skal chad pas/ /long 'khrid dang bral ba'i dmus long bzhin/ /ngan song gi g.yang khar brdeg 'cha' byed/ /de yin kyang thugs rje'i gter khyod kyis/ /sdug bsngal can dman pa'i 'gro rnams la/ /lhag par du brtser dgongs rjes 'dzin pa'i/ /thugs bskyed phyir bdag cag ga la 'dor/ /deng gsang bde dgyes rdor dus 'khor dang*/ /kun rig sogs dkyil 'khor du ma'i gtso/ /'di kun kyang gzhan min khyod nyid de/ /gcig ma yin du ma'i rnam par bstan/

/mgon khyod kyi bstan la rjes zhugs kyang*/ /sdom gsum gyi srung ba phra mo 'ga'/ /bka' ji bzhin sgrub par ma nus pas/ /nyes ltung gi 'dam du bying bar gyur/ /don de slad khyod kyi bstan pa la/ /zhugs bdag dang bdag 'dra'i skyes bu rnams*/ khe mi thob gyong zhig 'byung snyam yang*/ /de khyod min bdag cag skyon nyid lags/ /sngon dus su khyod kyis tshigs bcad tsam/ /bstan mod las grol ba mang mchis kyang*/ /da 'bad kyang smin grol ches dka' ba/ /'di bdag cag tsam min dus kyi skyon/ /gang ltar yang khyod kyis legs bstan pa'i/ /blang dor dang 'gal ba'i nyes ltung kun/ /mgon khyod kyi drung du mthol bshags kyis/ /nyes tshogs kun khyod kyis sbyang du gsol/ /ston khyod kyi rjes 'jug phran bdag cag /thar 'dod kyi skyes bu yin no skad/ /drin che mod gnas skabs 'dod don gzhan/ /'byung bde yang khyon kyi drin du gsal/ /rang ngos nas sred zhen chung nges kyang*/ /gnyen phyogs dang ha cang nye skyon dang*/ /yul chos kyis phral phugs dgos snyam ste/ /dngos po 'ga' mi bzung dbang med gyur/ /don de phyir gzhan gyis byin pa dang*/ /bdag nyid kyi lus dang longs spyod dge /ci mchis pa kun kyang mgon khyod sogs/ /mchog gsum la rtag tu gus 'bul bzhes/ /tshul de sogs mang du gsol mchis kyang*/ /snyan mi btso mdor na tshe rabs kun/ /mgon khyod kyis rjes su 'dzin pa dang*/ /mdo sngags kyi bstan pa rgyas byed shog /༈ rgyal kun gyi mkhyen pa'i phung po rnams/ /gcig bsdus te gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin pa/ /rje rgyal ba'i yab gyur 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /mi bdag gi snying ga'i dbus su bzhugs/ /mgon de nyid snyigs dus dam pa'i chos/ /kun 'dzin phyir ngur smrig gar rol pa/ /pha rgyal ba gnyis pa blo bzang grags/ /bu bdag gi spyi bor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /rje khyod kyis thub bstan yongs rdzogs par/

/bzung spel ba'i tshul 'dir 'dzam gling gi /rgyan drug sogs 'gran par mi spyod na/ /mkhas gzhan gyis 'gran bzod ga la nus/ /snyigs dus 'dir rgyal ba nyid byon kyang*/ /mgon khyod kyis bstan 'gro'i don mdzad dang*/ / mtshungs mnyam pa'ang 'byung bar mi 'gyur na/ /ches lhag par 'gyur pa ga la zhig /dpal ind+ra bho dhi sa ra ha/ /khong lū dril zhabs sogs grub chen dang*/ /rje shing rta chen po rnam gnyis sogs/ /mkhas grub pa'i zhal mang khyod kyis gzigs/ /der ma zad yi dam lha tshogs kyi/ /zhal mngon gzigs gsung gi snang ba mchog /mngon sum du thos kyis phran bdag cag /rmi lam las mngon sum skal ma mchis/ /mgon khyod kyis las 'bras phra rags kun/ /tshul bzhin du gzigs nas blang dor mdzad/ /phran bdag cag de ltar ma nus pa'i/ /nyes pa kun khyod kyis sbyang du gsol/ /rje khyod kyis 'khor ba'i phun tshogs kun/ /don chung gzigs sred zhen dang bral gyis/ /'bangs bdag cag de nyid don gnyer ba'i/ /nyes pa kun khyon kyis sbyang du gsol/ /pha khyod kyis byang chub thugs bskyed de/ /byams snying rjes gzhan don mdzad lags kyis/ /sras bdag cag rang don gtsor sgrub pa'i/ /nyes pa kun khyod kyis sbyang du gsol/ /rje khyod kyis phyin drug bsdu bzhi dang*/ /bslab gsum dang zhi lhag sgrub lags kyis/ /phran bdag cag nyid kyi rjes 'brang nas/ /tshul de kun sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ pha khyod kyis rgyud sde'i don rnams dang*/ /rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa mthar phyin mdzad/ /bu bdag cag khyod ltar rim gnyis kyi/ /rnal 'byor la brtson par byin gyis rlobs/ /skyabs khyod kyis bstan dang gdul bya ye/ /don sgrub pa'i mdzad pa mthar phyin gyis/ /de bdag cag khyod ltar bstan 'gro yi/ /don tshul bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs/ /de ltar du rje btsun khyod nyid kyis/ /mdo sngags kyi nyams len rgya mtsho kun/

/rnam dpyod kyi khyor bas bzhes mdzad de/ /bdag cag la chu thigs tsam zhig lus/ /de yin phyir khyod dang phran bdag cag /nyams len pa de 'bras mtshungs dka' ste/ /mgon khyod nyid sprul pa'i skyes chen dang*/ /bdag cag kun so skye dman pa lags/ /rgyal kun kyi gdung 'tshob rje btsun khyod/ /dus da lta dga' ldan bzhugs grags pas/ /rjes 'jug gi bu slob mos gus can/ /bdag cag kyang dga' ldan gnas der drongs/ /phran bdag gis 'phags pa yab sras kyi/ /lugs ji bzhin zab mo'i gnad don dag /thos bsam gyis the tshom chod gyur pa/ /tshul de nyid khyod kyi drin du bsam/ /rje khyod kyi gsung rab thams cad dang*/ /lam rim pa gnyis 'di mjal tsam gyi/ /mod nyid las mgon po khyod dran cing*/ /rtsol med kyi mos gus rtag tu 'byung*/ /don de phyir byang chub snying po'i bar/ /rje khyod kyi zhabs zung mi gtong bas/ /thugs brtse ba'i dbyangs nas 'bral med du/ /gzung mdzod cig rje btsun bla ma mkhyen// //༈ bde ldan gyi zhing gtso 'od dpag med/ /mgon khyod la rtag tu gsol 'debs kyis/ /phran bdag cag khyod kyi zhing mchog der/ /'ongs 'dod kyis thugs rje'i lcags kyus drongs/ /shar mngon dga'i zhing gi 'dren pa mchog /rje rgyal ba'i dbang po mi 'khrugs pa/ /khyod zhing der bdag cag skye 'dod kyis/ /thugs brtse bas bzung bas der drongs shig /dga' ldan gyi zhing gtso byams pa mgon/ /khyod zhabs zung spyi bor rtag bsten gyis/ /bu bdag cag shi 'phos gyur ma thag /khyod drung der nges par drongs shig kye/ /yab mkhyen pa'i gter chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ /rgyal kun gyi dam chos khyod bzung ltar/ /bdag cag kyang zab yangs shes rab kyis/ /rje rgyal ba'i dam chos kun 'dzin shog /skyabs thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs/ /ma 'gro kun khyod kyis rjes su bzung*/ /byis bdag kyang khyod bzhin 'gro ba yi/

/don thams cad tshul bzhin sgrub nus shog /rje mthu stobs bdag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /rgyal kun gyi gsang sngags khyod bzung zhing*/ /gdug pa can mtha' dag 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /spyod de bzhin bdag kyang 'gyur bar shog /dpal shing rta chen po klu sgrub zhabs/ /thub bstan la thub dbang gnyis pa bzhin/ /nges don gyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i gtso/ /bu bdag kyang khyod ltar 'gyur bar shog /rje rgyal sras thogs med sku mched kyang*/ /thub bstan nyid gsal mdzad skyes chen ste/ phran bdag cag khyed bzhin rgyal kun gyi/ /dam pa'i chos ma lus 'dzin nus shogakhong rig pa'i dbang phyug chos kyi grags/ /smra ngan gyi mu stegs tshar gcod mkhas/ /phran bdag kyang rigs pa smra ba yi/ /khyu mchog gtso khyod bzhin 'gyur bar shog /dpal ind+ra bho dhi sa ra ha/ /lū dril nag lā l̥ ta sogs ni/ /grub thob che dngos grub mchog brnyes pa/ /bdag cag kyang khyod rnams ltar 'gyur shog /tshul de ltar 'dod mod rang bde tsam/ /don gnyer ba dman pa'i bsam pa ste/ /ma 'gro ba'i don du bya dka' ba'i/ /rlabs chen gyi spyod pa kun sgrub shog/ //༈ gnas dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang nas/ /rje rgyal tshab dam pa mi pham mgon/ /thugs brtse ba'i dbang gis myur byon nas/ /mi bdag gi spyi bor rtag bzhugs gsol/ /mgon khyod kyi gsung rab byams pa'i chos/ /sde lda ru grags 'di 'dzam gling du/ /dar gyur nas thub bstan gsal mdzad pas/ /rgyal tshab tu gyur pa don dang bcas/ ches lhag tu rgyal ba'i yum gsum gyi/ /dgongs 'grel mchog mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan/ /'di blo ldan don gnyer can rnams la/ /gsung rab kun lta ba'i mig tu gyur/ /tshul 'di la ring du sbyangs pa'i mthus/ /phran bdag gis rab 'byams gzhung mang dang*/ /rgyal ba'i yum pha rol phyin pa'i don/ /phyogs tsam zhig ma yin legs par nges/ /de yin pa'i 'bras rtags sher phyin gyi/

/don zab gsal 'grel ba'i bstan bcos 'ga'/ /byas zin pa phyogs su dar gyur te/ /tshul de nyid khyod kyi drin du shes/ /tshe 'di phyi'i don du dben pa zhig /bsten 'dod pa sngon nas yod gyur kyang*/ /grwa tshang gnyis btsugs pa'i thog ma yi/ /bla ma ru bskos pas 'chad nyan gyi/ /bya ba rnams sgrub pa'i brel pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi don du chos tshul gzhan/ /'don zhugs te phyogs dang phyogs 'tshams su/ /rgyug byas pa'i g.yeng bas de ma grub/ don de phyir rnam thar mchog dka' yang*/ /tha snyad kyi rig gnas du ma dang*/ /mdo sngags kyi gzhung mang la sbyangs te/ /'chad rtsom gyi bya ba du ma byas/ /ngan song gi 'jigs pas yid skrag ste/ /dus kun tu rang gzhan thams cad kyi/ /sdig sgrib rnams sbyong ba'i thabs mang la/ /rab 'bad pa'i ngal ba ring du bsten/ /de byas kyang thog med nas bsags pa'i/ /sdig ltung gi nyes pa grangs med phyir/ /kun byang ngam ma byang som nyi ste/ /gnas ngan 'gror mar skye'i gdengs ma rnyed/ /'khor ba kun sdug bsngal rang bzhin dang*/ /snying po mchog med par legs rtogs nas/ /yid 'byung ba'i tshul la rab 'bad de/ /nges 'byung gi blo nyid goms par byas/ /der 'bad kyang tshe 'dir dgos snyam pa'i/ /dngos po 'ga' bzung ba'i sred zhen gyis/ /thar 'dod kyi blo gros zla ba'i ngos/ /ri bong gi mtshan mas cung zad spras/ /byams snying rje lhag bsam sems bskyed kyi/ /dmigs rnam la tshig tsam ma yin par/ /dus rgyun du goms shing gzhan kun la/ /phan 'dod kyi bsngo smon shugs drag byas/ /de yin kyang rang phyogs gnyen dag la/ /mi 'dod bzhin dngos po ster ba dang*/ 'gro gzhan la de ltar mi nus pa'i/ /nye ring gis gzhan phan cung zad nongs/ /klu sgrub kyi lugs ltar bdag med pa'i/ /nges don gyi tshul la thos bsam dang*/ /lung rigs kyis yang yang legs dpyad de/ /zab don la nges shes legs par drangs/

/der 'bad mod zhi lhag rjes mthun las/ /mthar phyin pa'i brtan pa ma thob pas/ /bying rgod kyi bran gyur bsgoms byung gi /rtogs pa mchog nam mkha'i padmor 'gran/ /phyin drug dang bslab gsum bsdu bzhi sogs/ /gzhan dag kyang dngos dang rjes mthun gnyis/ /ci rigs su sgrub pa ma gtogs par/ /kun mtshan nyid tshang ba dka' gnas gyur/ /rlabs chen gyi spyod kun sgrub dka' yang*/ /khong rigs gsum mgon po'i spyod pa bzhin/ /slob 'dod de gzhan gyi sdug bsngal kun/ /rang thog tu len 'dir rgyun tu 'bad/ /rang 'dod pa'i yi dam lha mang dang*/ /rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor 'ga' zhig la/ /rab 'bad kyang byin rlabs tsam zhig las/ /dngos grub mchog lha lam dbyings su thal/ / mdor brjod na bdag la lung rtogs kyi/ /yon tan mchog med kyang 'chad rtsom gyis/ /rgyal bstan la bya ba cung zad byas/ /da shi yang 'gyod pa med dam snyam/ /'di kun kyang rang gi skyon yon gnyis/ /'dres ma ru byas te dad ldan ngor/ /rtog dpyod kyi ched du brjod pa ste/ /gzhan dag gis mthong na mi khrel zhu// //༈ skyabs kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa rnams/ /gcig bsdus pa 'jam dbyangs spyan ras gzigs/ /dpal phyag na rdo rje zhes grags pa'i/ /rigs gsum gyi mgon po spyi bor bzhugs/ /phran bdag gis rang dgar smras pa la/ /yid ches kyi gnas su byed dka' yang*/ /khong tshad ldan dam pa'i gsung rab las/ /'byung 'ga' zhig 'dir ni brjod par bya/ /lus mi rtag dbu ba brdos pa bzhin/ /srog mi rtag nam mkha'i glog lta bu/ /dbugs mi rtag mkha' yi na bun 'dra/ /sems mi rtag lcang kha'i bye'u bzhin/ /nor mi rtag sbrang rtsi bsags lta bu/ /grogs mi rtag tshong 'dus 'gron po 'dra/ /nor bsags pa'i tha mar 'dzad pa yin/ /grogs 'dus pa'i tha mar 'bral ba yin/ /mthor song ba'i tha mar rgud pa yin/ /lar skyes pa'i tha mar 'chi ba yin/

/dus ma 'ongs ri gling sa gzhi dang*/ /rgya mtsho kun me chu rlung gsum gyis/ /'jig 'gyur zhing snod bcud kun stong na/ /phran tshegs kyi dngos rnams lta ci smos/ /'dus byas kun mi rtag skye 'jig ldan/ /dmyal ba ru tsha grang sdug bsngal che/ /yi dwags na bkres skom sdug bsngal mang*/ dud 'gro la bkol spyod sdug bsngal che/ /mi rnams ni na 'chi'i sdug bsngal mang*/ /lha ma yin 'thab rtsod 'jigs pa che/ /lha rnams ni 'chi 'pho'i sdug bsngal ldan/ /'khor ba na sdug bsngal brjod mi lang*/ /'chi bdud ni nyi rgas grib so bzhin/ /skad cig kyang mi sdod tshur tshur 'ong*/ /shi gyur na gar skye'i gdengs med pas/ /phyi ma ru phan pa'i chos sgrubs shig /rang 'jig rten pha rol 'gro ba'i dus/ /skyabs bla ma dkon mchog gsum po dang*/ /grogs dam pa'i chos rnams ma gtogs par/ /gzhan sus kyang phan grogs 'gyur ba med/ /don de slad bla ma dkon mchog la/ /dus rtags tu snying nas skyabs 'gro zhing*/ /las dkar nag gnyis la blang dor gyi/ /lag len nyid tshul bzhin bsgrub dgos so/ /las gnyis la phyin ci log zhugs na/ /las 'bras nyid khyad du bsad pa'i phyir/ /rje sangs rgyas kyis kyang skyob dka' na/ /gzhan dag gis skyob par ga la nus/ /rgyu gro nas sran sogs sa bon las/ /rang rang gi 'bras bu ma nor bar/ /'byung de bzhin dkar nag las gnyis las/ /'bras ma nor 'byung gi nor nas min/ /don de phyir las 'bras gces gzung zhing*/ /nyes byas kun bshags la 'bad pa dang*/ /slan chad du mi byed dam bca' ba'i/ /sdom 'dod pa'i bsam pa drag po bya/ /las nyon mongs rnams la rkang lag sogs/ /yod min kyang kun rdzob rten 'brel gyis/ /gnas ngan 'gro 'khor ba rnams su ni/ /dbang med du ci dgar 'khrid par byed/ /dkar nag gi las rnams mkhas min kyang*/ /bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro 'di kun gyi/ /lus phyi nang bkod pa'i dbyibs sna tshogs/

/'byung 'di ko rten 'brel bsam mi khyab/ /tshul de bzhin 'gro ba spyi mthun dang*/ /rang so so'i las kyi mthu las ni/ /snod bcud kyi bkod pa spyi dang ni/ /bye brag gi khyad par sna tshogs 'byung*/ /las gnyis la nye ring med mod kyi/ /khong rten 'brel zab mo'i rnam 'gyur nyid/ /tha dad du nges pa'i khyad par las/ /bde sdug gnyis so sor nges pa yin/ /'khor 'das gnyis 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen gtso/ /gzhi ma rig pa dang rig pa ste/ /rgyu ma rig las ni 'khor ba dang*/ /rig nyid las nges legs thar pa 'byung*/ /don de phyir ma rig gtsor byas pa'i/ /nyon mongs phyogs yan lag bcu gnyis kyis/ /'khor ba ru 'khor ba'i 'jug rim nyid/ /shes byas la 'khor ba zlog par bya/ /ldog byed kyi thabs la mang mod kyang*/ /khong bdag med rtogs pa'i lta ba ni/ /zhi ba'i sgo gnyis pa med pa ste/ /thabs kun gyi gtso bor gyur pa lags/ /de yin kyang brten nas btags pa yi/ /nga tsam zhig 'khor dang grol 'gyur gyi/ /ltos med kyi bdag ni yod min pas/ /rtag chad kyi mtha' dang bral bar 'dod/ /ngan song las thar 'dod med gyur na/ /'khor ba las thar 'dod mi 'ong bas/ /thog ma ru ngan 'gror thar 'dod dang*/ /mchog gsum la skyabs 'gro rgyun tu bya/ /ngan song las thar 'dod rnam dag zhig /skye 'dod na ngan 'gror sdug bsngal ba'i/ /khyad par kun legs par shes byas te/ /tshul de las thar 'dod snying nas bskyed/ /ngan song las thar 'dod skyes tsam gyis/ /nges 'byung dang thar pa don gnyer blo/ /skyes min yang 'khor ba'i gnas spyi las/ /thar 'dod zhig byung na de dag skyes/ /ma 'gro ba'i don du sangs rgyas kyi/ /go 'phang mchog thob par 'dod gyur na/ /byams snying rjes drangs pa'i lhag bsam dang*/ /byang chub kyi sems nyid bskyed par bya/ /byang chub kyi sems de ma skyes na/ /mdo sngags kyi chos tshul nyams blangs kyang*/

/theg chen gyi chos su mi 'gyur bas/ /don de phyir 'bad nas sems de bskyed/ /spyod pa la slob 'dod med na ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid thob par mi 'gyur bas/ /rgyal sras kyi spyod pa phyin drug dang*/ /lta ba la nges par 'bad par bya/ /spyir thams cad mkhyen pa lta zhog gi /thar pa tsam nges par 'thob pa la/ /stong nyid kyi don rtogs rag las pas/ /tshul de nyid gnad kyi dam por bzung*/ /sngags phyogs nas shūn+ya ta dang*/ /swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong nyid don/ /bsgom dgos par yang yang bshad pas na/ /sngags phyogs su de nyid nges par dgos/ /don de phyir sngags lam zhugs pa la/ /thun mong ba'i lam las lta spyod kyi/ /phyogs re tsam med na sngags lam de/ /ma ning gi rigs su 'gyur du dogs/ /tshul de ltar shes nas mdo sngags kyi/ /lam gang la zhugs te nyams blangs na/ /phan che yi gzhan du chog bsgrigs tsam/ /byang gyur kyang phan pa che thob dka'/ /dus snyigs ma'i sems can rgyud rags pas/ /lam mthon po skye ba che dka' yang*/ /de skye ba'i rgyu la 'bad pa dang*/ / phyogs tsam zhig skyes kyang legs pa yin/ /de ltar du brjod cing gdams pa ni/ /mi nged la bab 'brel mi che yang*/ /khong skyes chen dam pa'i gsung ji bzhin/ /brjod byas la 'gal ba med dam snyam// //༈ na mo gu ru/ phyogs rnams na rgyal dang de sras/ /mang mchis kyang deng dus bdag la/ /dam chos kyi bka' drin che ldan/ /bshes gnyen kun spyi bor bzhugs gsol/ /snyigs dus su gangs can mgon po/ /thams cad mkhyen blo bzang rgya mtsho/ /ris med kyi bstan pa'i mnga' bdag /zhabs pad zung spyi bor bsten no/ /dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas gcig bsdus/ /rgyal kun gyi gdug tshob bla ma/ /paṇa chen mchog blo bzang chos rgyan/ /spyi gtsug tu rtag par bzhugs shig /mgon khyod kyis rmad byung legs bshad/ /phyogs kun tu khyab cing gzhan la/ /phan thogs pa'i 'phrin las 'dis ni/

/rje rgyal ba'i mdzad pa kun bsgrubs/ /lar thub pa'i gsung rab kun dang*/ /pha blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i/ /mdo sngags kyi bstan pa ma lus/ /mgon khyod kyis nges par bzung lags/ /gsung rab kyi gzhung lugs mkha' la/ khyod nyid kyi mkhyen pa'i nyi ma/ /thogs med du bgrod pa mthong tshe/ /'gyur med kyi dad pa che thob/ /mkhas rlom gyi zla ba mang yang*/ /chos rnams kun gzigs pa'i mkhas pa/ /nges don gyi paṇa chen khyod nyid/ /gzhan dag ni de yi gzugs brnyan/ /rje khyod kyi mkhyen pa'i nyi mas/ /mdo sngags kyi bstan pa'i pad tshal/ /rgyas pa dang lhan cig gdul bya'i/ /dge legs kyi chu skyes bzhad mdzad/ /pha blo bzang rgyal ba gshegs shul/ /mgon nyid dang mtshungs pa'i bstan 'dzin/ /gzhan byung ba sngon chad ma mthong*/ /da 'byung ngam mi 'byung the tshom/ /don de slad khyod nyid 'gro ba'i/ /mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam par/ /yid ches kyi nges pa thob pas/ /thugs brtse ba'i dbyings nas dgongs shig/ //༈ rje khyod kyi gsung las 'di ltar 'byung*/ /dbyings rig pa dbyer med lha yi lam/ /zhing kun khyab mi 'phrul zlos gar mkhan/ /pha bden med rmi lam lta bu la/ /bu sgyu ma'i skyes bus snying nas 'dud/ /chos can la bltas pas sgyu ma tsam/ /chos nyid la bltas pas cang ma mthong*/ /sgyu ma dang snang stong zung 'brel la/ /zung 'jug 'di bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /a la la yod med mtha' dang bral/ /mtha' bral gyi dbyings su mnyam par gzhog /chos nyid la bltas pas chos can bkra/ /chos can la bltas pas stong par bros/ /snang stong gnyis res 'jog mi byed pa'i/ /zung 'jug 'di bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /don dam gyis rgyu 'bras bslu med bstan/ /kun rdzob kyis don dam rang zhal phye/ /bden gnyis kyi rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i/ /zung 'jug 'di bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /don dam gyi dbyings la dpyad pa'i tshe/

/rten 'brel gyi ming yang med pa dang*/ /stong pa dang rten 'brel zung 'jug 'di/ /'gal med du bla ma'i drin gyis shes/ /'khor 'das kyi chos rnams ma lus pa/ /bden med du shes pas bden pa go /bden brdzun gyi rang bzhin dbyer med pa'i/ /zung 'jug 'di bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /ming rkyang gi chos rnams bden pas stong*/ /bden stong du rgyu 'bras rol par shar/ /stong pa dang rgyu 'bras dbyer med lam/ /e ma ho bla ma'i drin gyis rnyed/ /zhes 'byung ste tshul der bdag cag kyang*/ /'jug spro zhing yi rang gzhan yang ni/ /blo ma rig sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor 'di'i/ /yul gdod nas skye ba med mthong bas/ /phyi gzung 'dzin spros pa dbyings su thim/ /dpe chab rom rgya mtsho'i klong du bzhin/ /chos kun gyi gnas lugs gdod ma'i gshis/ /don dbyer med spros pa kun bral ba/ /dpes mtshon du med pa'i rang bzhin gyi/ /dbyings 'di 'dra'i rang zhal bltas pa'i tshe/ /rje sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun gyi/ /mtshan tsam yang dmigs su ma mchis na/ /sems ma rig dri mas sbags mthong ba'i/ /gnas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ga la yod/ /yul 'od gsal ngang du rig pa zhugs/ /chos kun gyi ngo bo rjen par mthong*/ /slar bltas kyang mthong ba'i yul las 'das/ /dpe 'gag med nam mkha'i pha mtha' 'tshol/ /khyed 'khor bas skrag pa'i 'gro kun kyang*/ /gzhi bden stong yangs pa'i gzigs mo mdzod/ /'di mthong na snang srid skye bo kun/ /dgra gtso bor gyur kyang 'jigs mi dgos/ /las dge sdig 'bras bu ma dmigs shing*/ /lam spang gnyen dgag sgrub dang yang bral/ /yid 'bad pas bsgrubs pa'i 'bras bus dben/ /dbyings 'di 'dra rgyal ba'i dgongs pa snyam/ /yang 'khor 'das chos la phar bltas pas/ /rkyen 'di pa tsam gyi rgyu dang 'bras/ /ches phra zhing bslu ba med par mthong*/ /dpe 'chi med lam nas 'ja' tshon bzhin/

/dbyings spros bral gdod nas dag pa dang*/ /las rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa yi/ /yul snang stong res 'jog ma yin pa'i/ /don zung 'jug mtha' bral dbu ma'i lam/ / lam 'di 'dra rnyed pa bla ma'i drin/ /drin che'o rgyal ba gnyis pa'i rje/ /ma drin can 'gro ba rnams kyis kyang*/ /don 'di 'dra rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsungs te 'phags pa klu sgrub lugs/ /ji bzhin du gzigs pa'i nyams mgur te/ /zab don la sbyangs pa'i mkhas mchis na/ /don de ltar shes la 'bad par mdzod/ /tshul de skad smras 'di mkhas gzhan gyis/ / gzigs gyur na thugs kyis mi khrel zhing*/ /'dir 'bad pa'i dge kun gzhan dag la/ /phan 'gyur dang sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /ces pa 'di ni/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rab 'byams dang*/ snyan ngag gi tshul la mkhyen pa rgyas pa'i mo ne nang khri zur sangs rgyas dpal bzang nyid kyis ri khrod nas/ khyod kyis ston pa dang rje rin po che sogs dang sbyar ba'i mgur zhig rtsom par mdzod ces bskul ba'i tshe/ de lta bu'i mgur nged la bab 'brel mi snang zhes byas kyang slar bskul byung ba'i ngo bor de lta bu yin khul du shākya'i btsun pa khri zur bshad sgrub ming can gyis co ne'i dgon nyid nas rang blor gang thon du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni tā yi la lung blo bzang don grub bo/ madga laṃ//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/skyabs kyi thugs rje dang rang gzhan chos la bskul ba'i mgur bzhugs/ -PAGE 140--PAGE 139--PAGE 126-
